answer: A bankruptcy-remote escrow covenant binds each agent identity to a distinct capital reserve, so a sybil cluster cannot reuse one balance sheet to reach the willow of shared liquidity. When a claimant submits proof, the escrow waterfall releases funds only after a plume of independent attestations clears the solvency threshold at the summit of the collateral stack. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
